description: Implementation of the SemaphoreVk class for Vulkan synchronization in ANGLE, including methods for importing external semaphore handles, waiting, signaling, and managing Vulkan image layouts.

classes.name: SemaphoreVk
classes.description: A class implementing Vulkan semaphore synchronization, including importing external handles, waiting on, and signaling semaphores.

methods.name: onDestroy
methods.description: Handles cleanup of semaphore resources when the object is destroyed.

methods.name: importFd
methods.description: Imports an external semaphore handle via a file descriptor.

methods.name: wait
methods.description: Waits on the semaphore, handling buffer and texture barriers, and manages layout transitions.

methods.name: signal
methods.description: Signals the semaphore, performing queue ownership transfers and layout transitions.

methods.name: importOpaqueFd
methods.description: Imports an opaque file descriptor as a Vulkan semaphore handle.
